key.name: wallpaper
key.summary: Directory of the active Wallpaper Engine project (contains project.json)

key.name: monitor-wallpapers
key.summary: JSON object of project directories for individual monitors, keyed by connector name; other monitors show the default wallpaper

key.name: fit
key.summary: How video and scene wallpapers are scaled to the monitor

key.name: pause-mode
key.summary: Pause playback while every monitor is covered by a fullscreen (or maximized) window

key.name: show-on-lock-screen
key.summary: Keep the wallpaper playing behind the lock screen

key.name: system-background
key.summary: Set a still of the wallpaper as the desktop background

key.name: previous-background
key.summary: The desktop background (picture-uri, picture-uri-dark) to put back when the wallpaper stops

key.name: playlist
key.summary: Project directories of the wallpapers to rotate through

key.name: rotation-interval
key.summary: Minutes between playlist wallpapers; 0 turns rotation off

key.name: rotation-shuffle
key.summary: Pick the next playlist wallpaper at random

key.name: language
key.summary: Language of the picker window; empty to follow the system

key.name: paused
key.summary: Playback is paused by the user

key.name: extra-dirs
key.summary: Additional directories scanned for wallpaper projects

key.name: scene-renderer
key.summary: Path to the linux-wallpaperengine binary; empty to look it up in PATH

key.name: user-properties
key.summary: JSON object of per-wallpaper property overrides, keyed by project directory

key.name: blur-my-shell-defaults-applied
key.summary: Whether Blur my Shell has been set to show the windows behind the Dock and the top bar
